name: anthropic-warm-editorial
title: Anthropic Warm Editorial
description: Warm parchment and stone surfaces with literary serif headings, calm clay accents, and generous long-form reading measure.

typography.fontFamily: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Palatino, Georgia, serif
typography.displayFamily: Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, Book Antiqua, Palatino, Georgia, serif

rules: Optimize for calm reading with a 60–72ch measure, warm paper, and literary hierarchy.
Use clay accents for links and selected actions rather than decorative washes.
Pair serif narrative headings with quiet system sans for controls and dense metadata.
Prefer thin stone rules and generous margins over boxed cards and heavy elevation.
Display headings use 1.05–1.2 line-height; body copy uses 1.6–1.75.
Do not mix more than three weights; italic and measure can provide additional hierarchy.
Keep form labels persistent and error language constructive and specific.
Illustration and imagery must share the warm tonal palette and never reduce text contrast.
Use 8px and 12px radii sparingly; pills belong to compact metadata only.
Motion is soft but brief, and all reading or navigation remains complete without animation.
